WELCOME_SUB: Isango Lokupha Amandla i-Afrika Nge-Pi Ecosystem
AFRICA_DAY: (Ngokugubha uSuku lwe-25 lwe-Afrika, Le App yokuQeqesha AmaPhayona ePi yethulwe)
INTRO_P1: I-Pi Network yiphrojekthi yemali yedijithali kanye ne-ecosystem yomhlaba wonke eklanyelwe ukwenza i-cryptocurrency ifinyeleleke futhi ibe usizo kuwo wonke umuntu.
INTRO_P2: Ngokungafani nama-cryptocurrencies endabuko avame ukudinga imishini yezimayini ebizayo kanye nogesi omningi, i-Pi Network ivumela abantu abavamile ukuba babambe iqhaza ngqo kumafoni abo.
INTRO_P3: Umbono we-Pi Network wukwakha i-ecosystem eqhutshwa ngabantu lapho imali yedijithali ingasetshenziselwa ukusetshenziswa kwangempela, izinsizakalo zangempela, imiphakathi yangempela kanye nokubamba iqhaza kwezomnotho kwangempela.
M1: Ukwakha umnotho wedijithali obandakanya wonke umuntu
M2: Ukunika amandla abantu abavamile emhlabeni wonke
CH1_SUB: Wamukelwa eSikhungweni Sokufundisa AmaPhayona e-Afrika - Ngaphandle. Le nkundla yakhelwe ukufundisa, ukunika amandla nokulungiselela amaphayona e-Afrika namabhizinisi ukuthi abambe iqhaza ngendlela enenjongo kwi-Pi Ecosystem.
DAILY_MINING: Izimayini Zansuku Zonke: Buya njalo emahoreni angama-24 ukuze uqhubeke nokumba.
WALLET_SEC: Ukuvikeleka kwe-Wallet: Ungalokothi wabelane ngamagama akho angama-24 e-Passphrase. Noma ubani onalawo magama ungumnikazi we-wallet.
CH2_DESC: Funda indlela yokwamukela nokuthumela i-Pi ngokuphepha usebenzisa i-Pi Wallet ku-Pi Browser.
CH2A_DESC: Qala ngemali encane yokuhlola, qinisekisa ikheli, ungalokothi wabelane nge-passphrase yakho.
CH3_DESC: I-Pi Browser DApps yizicelo ezihlukanisiwe zokusetshenziswa kwangempela.
CH4_DESC: Thola amabhizinisi amukela i-Pi emhlabeni wonke.
CH5_DESC: Inani Lesivumelwano Somhlaba (GCV) likhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwangempela ku-ecosystem.
CH6_DESC: Funda incwadi ka-Doris Yin yokudala ukusetshenziswa kanye nokukhula kwe-ecosystem.
MERCHANT_DESC: Indlela yokujoyina i-ecosystem, ukufaka uhlu ibhizinisi lakho ku-MapOfPi, ukwamukela inkokhelo ye-Pi.
FINAL_P: I-Afrika inethuba lokuba enye yezindawo ezinamandla kakhulu ekusebenziseni okusebenzayo ngaphakathi kwe-Pi Ecosystem. Sakha Ndawonye. Sifundisa Ndawonye. Sinika Amandla i-Afrika Ndawonye Nge-Pi.
